seoTitle: Dr Ishan Shah - Silver Touch Hospital
html:
Qualification
MS, DNB (Urology, Gold Medalist)

All India First Rank.

Received President Gold Medal award in Urology field by Hon’ble Union Health Minister of India.

Dr Ishan Shah is an experienced and enthusiastic Urologist in Ahmedabad.

Expertise:

  • Endoscopic Kidney, Ureter, Bladder stone removal (PCNL, URSL, CLT, RIRS)
  • Stricture Urethra (VIU, BMG)
  • BPH (TURP, BNI), TURBT
  • Kidney, Bladder, Prostate Cancer
  • Urinary tract Infection Male Infertility
